title: Vanishing higher direct images: cohomology of the direct image equals cohomology upstairs
statement: Let $f:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a morphism of sites given by the continuous functor $u:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (3), with $f_*=u^s$, $f^{-1}=u_s$, unit $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to f_*f^{-1}$ and counit $\varepsilon:f^{-1}f_*\to\mathrm{id}$ of $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$ on abelian sheaves. For $\mathcal F\in\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ let $R^qf_*\mathcal F$ ($q\ge0$) be the right derived functors of the left exact functor $f_*:\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)\to\textit{Ab}(\mathcal D)$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive], computed from an injective resolution of $\mathcal F$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let $V\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal D)$ and, for $p\ge0$, let the edge map $e^p_{V,\mathcal F}:H^p(V,f_*\mathcal F)\to H^p(u(V),\mathcal F)$ be the composite of the pullback $f^*:H^p(V,f_*\mathcal F)\to H^p(u(V),f^{-1}f_*\mathcal F)$ of [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback] with $H^p(u(V),\varepsilon_{\mathcal F})$ ($H^p$ over an object as in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (2)). If $R^qf_*\mathcal F=0$ for all $q>0$, then $e^p_{V,\mathcal F}$ is an isomorphism for every $p\ge0$. (In degree $0$ it is the identity of $(f_*\mathcal F)(V)=\mathcal F(u(V))$, by the triangle identity $\varepsilon_{\mathcal F}(u(V))\circ\eta_{f_*\mathcal F}(V)=\mathrm{id}$.)

proof.text: For the unchanged Lean existential conclusion, use the two resolution-to-cohomology isomorphisms directly. Obtain finite-limit preservation of abelian inverse image from the underlying-set comparison and reflection of limits by forgetful sheaves. Its adjunction to pushforward gives preservation of injectives; the right adjunction also gives preservation of limits by pushforward. This uses no cover-preservation or pullback-preservation assumptions beyond those in the existing Lean signature.

Choose I = injectiveResolution F. Construct mapResolution T I he explicitly with cocomplex T(I), injective terms, and augmentation obtained by fromSingle₀Equiv from T.map(I.ι.f 0). KernelFork.mapIsLimit gives the quasi-isomorphism in degree zero, using quasiIsoAt₀_iff and ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff_of_zeros. For n+1, isoRightDerivedObj identifies homology with the assumed zero higher derived image, hence T(I) is exact there. This constructs an injective resolution P of T(F) without a new existence lemma or hole.

The continuous pushforward is precomposition, so T followed by sections at V equals sections at U(V), on objects and morphisms. The complex-composition comparison and the homology functor identify the homology of sections of P with that of sections of I. Apply the existing natural object-cohomology/right-derived-sections comparison on both sites, and compute those derived functors using P and I via isoRightDerivedObj. Compose these isomorphisms.

Keep the arbitrary Ext universe of the original signature. For each site use extAddEquivCohomologyClass first in the given Ext universe and then in universe u, with the SAME chosen resolution and representing free sheaf. The latter HasExt follows from enough injectives. Compose through the common cohomology-class group, the small-universe comparison of the preceding step, and the inverse large-universe comparison. This gives an additive equivalence and hence an isomorphism in the original universe. Choose its hom for each p,V; IsIso of each hom completes the existential conclusion. No claim of identification with the specified pullback-counit map is added.

split_report.summary: Not a Mathlib leaf (no Leray spectral sequence or higher direct images for sites in Mathlib; searches recorded). Split by the direct argument that Stacks 0733's proof leaves as an exercise, avoiding the spectral sequence 0732: f_* is left exact additive and f_* of an injective resolution F -> I is an injective resolution of f_*F (f_* of injectives is injective, right adjoint of the exact f^{-1}, Homology 015Z / Sites-Cohomology 0730; exactness from R^q f_*F = 0 and the degree-0 lemma). Computing the pullback f^* of lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback with this resolution and H^p(u(V), counit) with a lift psi, psi.beta is homotopic to the termwise counit (lift-to-injective uniqueness), and the triangle identity makes the chain map the identity of Gamma(V,f_*I)=Gamma(u(V),I); so the stated edge map (not just some isomorphism) is the composite of the two identifications iota, hence an isomorphism; degree 0 is the identity. Statement unchanged; stmt_deps unchanged. No new nodes. Uses lem-sp-right-adjoint-preserves-injectives of unit sk-thm-groth-ss as a tool (already recorded as tool on lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites-injective-system); that node has Mathlib candidate CategoryTheory.Injective.injective_of_adjoint (Preadditive/Injective/Basic.lean:195).
